body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon or unarmed range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. One ally within 4 units gains +1 die on its next attack against that creature.

surges.html: A second ally may receive one non-damage benefit of this card.
One affected enemy cannot willingly target creatures other than you until the start of its next turn unless you are ineligible.

rider.title: EXAMPLE — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority after you suffer damage: 1–3 one ally gains +1 Defense; 4–5 one ally rolls +1 die on its next Action; 6+ one ally becomes Rallied and may move 1 unit.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
